character_facts: The white-robed man is calm under threat and speaks as if directing a societal project.
He considers his opponents ethically deficient.
He claims specialized training let him transcend or shed physical embodiment.
The dark-haired attacker is openly hostile and impatient with his speech.
All three attackers act together and use similar energy weapons.
characters_present: A pale, white-robed male figure at the center of the confrontation
A dark-haired attacker who speaks the death threat
A blond attacker firing an energy weapon
A dark-skinned attacker firing an energy weapon
continuity_links: This page depicts the apparent payoff to an earlier 'false oasis' plan mentioned in the dialogue.
The reference to returning to the 'techno-tech no zone' implies an ongoing storyline about that place and the people being moved from it.
dialogue_meaning: The white-robed figure claims a major relocation is underway after creating a false oasis.
He says dreamers and thousands of old technologists are being sent to another galaxy.
He presents his plan as a moral reset: a healthier society built on human bonds rather than scientific advancement.
He accuses the armed trio of moral emptiness.
The dark-haired attacker rejects his speech and attempts to execute him.
The white-robed figure says long training allowed him to free himself from corporeal form, explaining why the attack does not stop him conventionally.
locations: A futuristic interior chamber or hall
An area associated in dialogue with a return to the 'techno-tech no zone'
lore_facts: This setting includes 'dreamers' and 'technotechnicians' as distinct groups mentioned in dialogue.
A large-scale transfer to a 'promised galaxy' is stated to be in progress.
The speaker contrasts social or relational well-being with scientific advancement as competing civilizational values.
At least one character in this world can separate from bodily form through training.
Energy weapons or energy-projecting devices are used by the attackers.
plot_events: A pale man explains that dreamers and old technologists will be relocated to a 'promised galaxy.'
He frames this as the start of a new society that values healthy human relationships above scientific progress.
He condemns his opponents as lacking conscience.
One of the attackers cuts him off and declares the lesson over, threatening to kill him.
Three attackers fire energy blasts at close range.
The target does not visibly resist in a physical way and instead transforms or disperses into a radiant, swirling phenomenon.
uncertainties: Some dialogue is small and partially hard to read; wording may be approximate.
Character names are not given on this page, so figures are described by appearance and role only.
The exact nature of the final phenomenon is unclear from the page alone: it could be disintegration, ascension, teleportation, or projection-loss rather than literal death.
visual_summary: In a futuristic chamber, three dark-clad figures confront a pale, white-robed man standing before a large organic-looking structure. He speaks calmly while the trio aim circular weapons at him. A close-up of the central attacker shows an angry face and a death threat. The three fire bright energy blasts; the white-robed figure is engulfed in a huge burst of light and then seems to disperse into a swirling, star-like vortex rather than falling as a body.
